[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
8th December, 2001]
No. Legis.l‑125/Law/2000,
dated 8‑12‑2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 4th December, 2001, is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title, extent and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Balochistan Foodstuffs Whole Sale and Retail Dealers (Cancellation of
Authorization) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th days of August, 2001.

No. Legis.l‑125/Law/2000,
dated 8‑12‑2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 4th December, 2001, is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Ordinance V of 1979.-----In the Balochistan Foodstuffs Whole Sale and
Retail Dealers (Cancellation of Authorizations) Ordinance, 1979, in section 2:
---
(a) in subsection (1) for the
words Commissioner and District Magistrate the words District Coordination
Officer and Assistant Director Food shall be substituted.
(b) In the Explanation of subsection (2) for the word
Commissioner the words District Coordination Officer shall be substituted.
